decisive_items: Large, slow scotopic and photopic responses
Complete loss of photoreceptors, ellipsoid zone, and retinal pigment epithelium in superotemporal region
response.rationale: ERG shows large, slow responses typical of cone-rod dystrophy, with preserved central macula and peripheral photoreceptor loss; RP is less likely due to absent pigmentary degeneration and atypical ERG pattern.

rejected.why: Choroideremia typically shows diffuse RPE/choroidal atrophy and severely reduced ERG, not large slow responses or focal superotemporal loss.
Choroidal dystrophy is nonspecific and lacks the characteristic ERG and OCT findings.
Retinitis pigmentosa usually has pigmentary degeneration and severely reduced rod ERG, not large slow responses; fundus shows no pigment.
